road.title: Weather and seasons
road.description: A small, square figure in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Gideon is a Curator of Seasons and keeps the three that are not in use, folded, and is particular about the order they go back in.

character.name: Gideon Bracket
character.description: A small, square figure in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Gideon is a Curator of Seasons and keeps the three that are not in use, folded, and is particular about the order they go back in.

npc.narrative: You reach the pascolo at mezzogiorno, under a cielo without a single nuvola. Gideon Bracket stands by the recinto, counting tre folded things with a matita. Beside him a cancello is open, though the sentiero beyond it is not, apparently, until più tardi.
npc.native: Buongiorno, sono Gideon Bracket, custode delle stagioni. Qui tutti mi chiedono: «Che tempo fa?» e «Quale stagione preferisci?». Ieri ha piovuto e ha fatto freddo, ma oggi il cielo è chiaro. E tu, com'era il tempo da te ieri, e che cosa vuoi sapere di me?
npc.translation: Good day, I am Gideon Bracket, keeper of the seasons. Here everyone asks me: "What is the weather like?" and "Which season do you prefer?". Yesterday it rained and it was cold, but today the sky is clear. And you, what was the weather like where you are yesterday, and what do you want to know about me?

player: Buongiorno Gideon! Ieri da me ha fatto caldo e c'era il sole. Che tempo fa oggi qui? È bello?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You greeted Gideon, described yesterday's weather and asked about today's, all in correct Italian. Next time, try asking him about his favourite season too.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you asked what the weather is like with "Che tempo fa oggi qui?".
You didn't ask Gideon which season he likes best yet; try asking him that, and Gideon will give you another chance later.
Great, you told Gideon what the weather was like yesterday with "ha fatto caldo".

npc.narrative: It is mezzogiorno, and the sole stands exactly where it should. Gideon Bracket sits on a panca beside tre coperte, folded, each in its posto. He looks at the cielo, poi at you, con calma.
npc.native: Buongiorno! Oggi fa bello: il cielo è chiaro e c'è il sole. Ieri da te c'era il sole, che bella giornata! Io tengo tre stagioni piegate e una fuori, e tutti vogliono sapere quale stagione è. E tu, che cosa fai oggi, e che cosa vuoi sapere di me?
npc.translation: Good morning! Today the weather is nice: the sky is clear and there is sun. Yesterday at your place there was sun, what a lovely day! I keep three seasons folded and one outside, and everyone wants to know which season it is. And you, what are you doing today, and what do you want to know about me?

player: Oggi cammino sulla strada. Quale stagione preferisci tu?

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice work: you told Gideon what you are doing today and asked him a clear question about his favourite season. Next, try telling him about yesterday's weather.

objectiveResults.feedback: You asked Gideon which season he likes best, in good Italian.
You haven't yet told Gideon what the weather was like yesterday. Gideon will ask again later, so you can try then.

openObjectives.prompt: Gideon missed yesterday entirely and is piecing it together from witnesses. Tell Gideon what the weather was like yesterday, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The sole stands over the strada while Gideon Bracket hangs a wet cappotto on a palo, like a man long past being surprised by cappotti. Three scatole sit nearby, chiuse. He looks at you with the calm of un uomo who has all day, and opening hours that say otherwise.
npc.native: Cammini sulla strada, che bello! Io preferisco l'autunno, ma nella scatola è sempre l'ultimo. Ieri qui ha piovuto e ha fatto freddo, e il mio cappotto è ancora bagnato. E da te, sulla strada, che tempo ha fatto ieri? Dove vai oggi?
npc.translation: You walk on the road, how nice! I prefer autumn, but in the box it is always the last one. Yesterday here it rained and it was cold, and my coat is still wet. And where you are, on the road, what was the weather like yesterday? Where are you going today?

player: Ho detto: ieri faceva caldo! C'era sole. Vado al villaggio. Io preferisco l'estate.

correction.text: Ho detto: ieri faceva caldo! C'era il sole. Vado al villaggio. Io preferisco l'estate.
correction.translation: I said: yesterday it was hot! There was the sun. I'm going to the village. I prefer summer.

verdict.overallFeedback: You told Gideon the weather yesterday, where you are going and which season you like, all in Italian. Just one tiny fix: say \"c'era il sole\" with \"il\".

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, "ieri faceva caldo" tells Gideon clearly what the weather was like yesterday.

correction.text: Ho detto: ieri faceva caldo! C'era il sole. Vado al villaggio. Io preferisco l'estate.
correction.translation: I said: yesterday it was hot! There was the sun. I'm going to the village. I prefer summer.

npc.narrative: Gideon nods, like a man whose conti have balanced. He lifts the lid of the scatola, checks the three stagioni piegate, and closes it in the proper ordine. Above the strada, the cielo is perfectly vuoto, at mezzogiorno.
npc.native: Bravo! Ieri da te faceva caldo e c'era il sole. Qui ieri pioveva e faceva freddo, e il mio cappotto è ancora bagnato. Tu preferisci l'estate, ma io tengo l'estate piegata nella scatola! Che cosa fai al villaggio oggi, e che cosa pensi del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Well done! Yesterday where you are it was hot and there was sun. Here yesterday it rained and it was cold, and my coat is still wet. You prefer summer, but I keep summer folded in the box! What are you doing in the village today, and what do you think of my work?

player: Al villaggio compro il pane. Ma... l'estate è nella scatola? Allora adesso che stagione è?

npc.narrative: Gideon lifts the coperchio of the scatola and shows you something giallo and folded, smelling faintly of fieno. Beside it lie due more, in an order he checks twice before closing it piano. Above the villaggio the cielo is perfectly chiaro, and nobody has ever seen the hours written down.
npc.native: Sì, l'estate è nella scatola, piegata con cura. Adesso è autunno, e l'autunno è fuori: il cielo è chiaro, ma l'aria è fresca. Il pane del villaggio è buono! Che pane compri di solito, e che cosa vuoi chiedere del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Yes, summer is in the box, folded with care. Now it is autumn, and autumn is outside: the sky is clear, but the air is cool. The bread of the village is good! What bread do you usually buy, and what do you want to ask about my work?

player: Compro il pane bianco. Posso vedere l'inverno nella scatola? Fa freddo?

npc.narrative: Gideon lifts the coperchio of the scatola with molta cura, like a man opening a letter from the guild. Dentro, the inverno lies folded, a little frosted at the edges, and a cold breath slips out piano. The midday sun stays well back, as if it had been told.
npc.native: Il pane bianco è buono! Sì, puoi vedere l'inverno, ma solo un momento. Nella scatola fa molto freddo, e c'è un po' di neve sul fondo. Che cosa pensi del mio lavoro, e che cosa vuoi sapere ancora delle stagioni?
npc.translation: White bread is good! Yes, you can see the winter, but only for a moment. In the box it is very cold, and there is a little snow at the bottom. What do you think of my work, and what else do you want to know about the seasons?

player: Che bello! C'è neve! Il tuo lavoro è magico. Dove è la primavera?

npc.narrative: Gideon lifts the coperchio of the scatola a finger's width, and a small freddo wind comes out to inspect your scarpe. He shuts it again subito, because the order matters. Under the neve, something is pretending to be asleep, molto badly.
npc.native: Grazie! La primavera è nella scatola, sotto l'inverno, e dorme. L'ordine è importante: prima l'inverno, poi la primavera, e poi l'estate. Il pane bianco è buono con il formaggio, ma tu che cosa mangi al villaggio? E che cosa vuoi sapere ancora del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Thank you! Spring is in the box, under the winter, and it sleeps. The order is important: first winter, then spring, and then summer. White bread is good with cheese, but what do you eat in the village? And what else do you want to know about my work?
